title: Warm Flaky Japanese Red Cabbage Nabemono
description: A kid-friendly Japanese dish from the Chubu region featuring red cabbage, with a jammy and flaky texture, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This nabemono is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded red cabbage and cook until it is slightly wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and mirin.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the pot and stir to combine.
Add the dashi broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 minutes or until the cabbage is tender.
Stir in the chopped green onions and serve hot.
